_market.zh: SPY 灯红（三条过一条），QQQ 灯绿（三条全过），交通灯判 avoid；广度 MIXED −2，Regime Damaged 37.5，系统口径 Reduced / selective。30 个主题里 0 个 Leading，19 个在加速，半导体、存储、AI 数据中心、光通信都在其中，和 QQQ 同一边。
_market.en: SPY's light is red (one of three checks), QQQ's is green (all three), and the traffic light reads avoid; breadth is MIXED −2, Regime Damaged 37.5, system stance Reduced / selective. Of 30 themes none is Leading and 19 are accelerating, semis, memory, AI datacenters and optical networking among them, on QQQ's side of the tape.

STX.zh: 回踩停在 21EMA 上方 0.84 ATR；Memory & Storage 在加速（+39.5），一个月跑赢 SPY 13.3%，和今天亮绿灯的 QQQ 站在同一边。
STX.en: Pulled back to 0.84 ATR above the 21EMA; Memory & Storage is accelerating (+39.5) and beat SPY by 13.3% over a month, on the same side as today's green-lit QQQ.

RNG.zh: 组内 RS 第 99 百分位，自己很强；但 Cloud Software 从 Leading 退到 Weakening、减速 −33.6，一个月落后 SPY 9.4%。强票在走弱的组里回踩。
RNG.en: 99th percentile RS inside its group, so the stock itself is strong; but Cloud Software slid from Leading to Weakening, decelerating −33.6 and trailing SPY by 9.4% over a month. A strong name pulling back in a weakening group.

INTC.zh: 一个月 +29.5%，Semiconductors Broad 连着三档 Improving、加速 +34.5；离 21EMA 0.98 ATR，贴着回踩区间的上沿，回得最浅。
INTC.en: Up 29.5% in a month; Semiconductors Broad has read Improving three steps running, accelerating +34.5. At 0.98 ATR from the 21EMA it sits at the top edge of the pullback band, the shallowest pullback here.

PBF.zh: 没有主题归属，看行业：炼油在减速（−26.5），一个月只剩跑赢 SPY 1.0%；PBF 组内第 89 百分位，回踩到 21EMA 上方 0.41 ATR。
PBF.en: No theme, so read the industry: refiners are decelerating (−26.5) and now lead SPY by only 1.0% over a month; PBF ranks 89th percentile in the group, 0.41 ATR above the 21EMA.

VLO.zh: 炼油组在减速（−26.5）；VLO 组内第 61 百分位，四只炼油里 RS 排位最低。
VLO.en: Refiners are decelerating (−26.5); VLO is 61st percentile in its group, the lowest RS rank of the four refiners.

MPC.zh: 炼油组在减速（−26.5）；MPC 离 21EMA 只剩 0.15 ATR，四只炼油里回踩最深。
MPC.en: Refiners are decelerating (−26.5); MPC is just 0.15 ATR above the 21EMA, the deepest pullback of the four refiners.

CVI.zh: 炼油组在减速（−26.5）；CVI 一个月 +20.8%，离 50SMA 3.75 ATR，四只里离均线最远，接近 4 ATR 的上限。
CVI.en: Refiners are decelerating (−26.5); CVI is up 20.8% in a month and 3.75 ATR above the 50SMA, the furthest of the four from its average and close to the 4 ATR edge.

LPG.zh: Midstream 在减速（−14.8），一个月落后 SPY 6.4%；LPG 组内第 98 百分位，今年 EPS +1264%，离 21EMA 0.22 ATR。
LPG.en: Midstream is decelerating (−14.8) and trails SPY by 6.4% over a month; LPG is 98th percentile in its group, EPS +1264% this year, 0.22 ATR above the 21EMA.

TNK.zh: Midstream 在减速（−14.8）、落后 SPY 6.4%；TNK 组内第 95 百分位，回踩到 21EMA 上方 0.57 ATR。
TNK.en: Midstream is decelerating (−14.8) and trails SPY by 6.4%; TNK is 95th percentile in its group, 0.57 ATR above the 21EMA.

TEN.zh: Midstream 在减速（−14.8）；TEN 离 52 周高 12.4%，同组三只里离高点最远。
TEN.en: Midstream is decelerating (−14.8); TEN is 12.4% off its 52-week high, the furthest from its high of the three in the group.

PANW.zh: 离 52 周高只差 2.6%；但 Cybersecurity 已从 Leading 退到 Weakening，减速 −10.5，一个月还跑赢 SPY 1.8%。
PANW.en: Only 2.6% off its 52-week high; but Cybersecurity has slipped from Leading to Weakening, decelerating −10.5, though still 1.8% ahead of SPY over a month.

FTNT.zh: Cybersecurity 在走弱（−10.5）；FTNT 离高点 3.0%、离 21EMA 0.96 ATR，和 PANW 几乎同一个位置。
FTNT.en: Cybersecurity is weakening (−10.5); FTNT is 3.0% off its high and 0.96 ATR above the 21EMA, almost exactly where PANW sits.

QLYS.zh: Cybersecurity 在走弱（−10.5）；QLYS 一个月 −4.2%，离高点 11.5%，组在掉，它自己也在掉。
QLYS.en: Cybersecurity is weakening (−10.5); QLYS is down 4.2% in a month and 11.5% off its high, falling along with its group.

S.zh: Cybersecurity 在走弱（−10.5）；S 离高点 4.5%，一个月 +5.5%，组内第 83 百分位。
S.en: Cybersecurity is weakening (−10.5); S is 4.5% off its high, up 5.5% in a month, 83rd percentile in its group.

ESTC.zh: 挂两个主题，按三个月超额取 Cybersecurity，在走弱；ESTC 一个月 −9.0%，离高点 17.8%。
ESTC.en: Belongs to two themes; by 3-month excess it reads as Cybersecurity, which is weakening. ESTC is down 9.0% in a month and 17.8% off its high.

AMPL.zh: Cloud Software 减速 −33.6、一个月落后 SPY 9.4%；AMPL 自己一个月 −3.3%，跟着组一起回落。
AMPL.en: Cloud Software is decelerating −33.6 and trails SPY by 9.4% over a month; AMPL is down 3.3% itself, sliding with the group.

DOCU.zh: Cloud Software 减速 −33.6；DOCU 离 21EMA 只有 0.06 ATR，离高点 18.2%。
DOCU.en: Cloud Software is decelerating −33.6; DOCU sits only 0.06 ATR above the 21EMA, 18.2% off its high.

WT.zh: 没有主题归属；行业 Asset Management 在 Lagging、减速 −9.3。WT 组内第 93 百分位，今年 EPS +65%。
WT.en: No theme; its industry, Asset Management, is Lagging and decelerating −9.3. WT is 93rd percentile in the group, EPS +65% this year.

TGB.zh: Copper Miners 三档 Leading → Improving → Weakening，减速 −22.5；TGB 一个月 −1.8%。
TGB.en: Copper Miners went Leading → Improving → Weakening over three steps, decelerating −22.5; TGB is down 1.8% in a month.

ERO.zh: Copper Miners 在走弱（−22.5）；ERO 组内排第一（第 100 百分位），营收 +74%。
ERO.en: Copper Miners are weakening (−22.5); ERO ranks first in its group (100th percentile), revenue +74%.

PRCH.zh: 没有主题归属；行业 P&C 保险微弱加速（+1.6），一个月仍落后 SPY 3.5%。PRCH 几乎压在 21EMA 上（0.01 ATR）。
PRCH.en: No theme; P&C insurance is barely accelerating (+1.6) and still trails SPY by 3.5% over a month. PRCH is sitting right on the 21EMA (0.01 ATR).

DIOD.zh: Semiconductors Broad 连着三档 Improving、加速 +34.5；但 DIOD 离 52 周高 22.9%，快碰到 §11.1 的 25% 线。
DIOD.en: Semiconductors Broad has read Improving three steps running, accelerating +34.5; but DIOD is 22.9% off its 52-week high, close to §11.1's 25% line.

GLBE.zh: 个股自己是 Leading，行业 Internet Retail 却在 Lagging，一个月落后 SPY 7.6%。组弱票强。
GLBE.en: The stock itself reads Leading while its industry, Internet Retail, is Lagging and trails SPY by 7.6% over a month. A strong name in a weak group.

HOOD.zh: 个股 Leading，但 Fintech 三档 Weakening → Weakening → Lagging，一个月落后 SPY 9.6%；离 52 周高 24.5%，贴着 §11.1 的 25% 线。
HOOD.en: The stock reads Leading, but Fintech went Weakening → Weakening → Lagging and trails SPY by 9.6% over a month; HOOD is 24.5% off its 52-week high, right at §11.1's 25% line.

XP.zh: 个股 Leading、组内第 82 百分位；行业 Capital Markets 在 Lagging。离 50SMA 3.0 ATR，一个月 +11.2%。
XP.en: The stock reads Leading, 82nd percentile in its group; its industry, Capital Markets, is Lagging. 3.0 ATR above the 50SMA, up 11.2% in a month.

WOR.zh: 个股 Leading；行业 Metal Fabrication 在 Lagging（−7.2）。今年 EPS +1134%。
WOR.en: The stock reads Leading; its industry, Metal Fabrication, is Lagging (−7.2). EPS +1134% this year.

ANDG.zh: ⚠️ RS 评级 1，组内却是第 100 百分位，两个读数互相矛盾。先当数据问题查，别当候选。
ANDG.en: ⚠️ RS rating 1, yet 100th percentile inside its group: the two readings contradict each other. Treat it as a data problem to check, not a candidate.

IOVA.zh: 今天 +31.5%，四条资格全过；离 21EMA 5.3 ATR、50SMA 8.0 ATR，已经远离均线，EP 本来就长这样。行业 Biotechnology 在 Lagging。
IOVA.en: Up 31.5% today with all four conditions met; 5.3 ATR above the 21EMA and 8.0 ATR above the 50SMA, already far from its averages, which is what an EP looks like. Industry: Biotechnology, Lagging.

ABSI.zh: Genomics 从 Weakening 回到 Improving，加速 +1.2；ABSI RS 98，离 52 周高 15.9%。
ABSI.en: Genomics swung from Weakening back to Improving, accelerating +1.2; ABSI has RS 98 and is 15.9% off its 52-week high.
